name: Cashel Blue Cheese
shortDesc: Renowned Cashel Blue Cheese is hand crafted in small batches to the original family recipe. Celebrated for its award-winning taste – it has become Ireland Queen of the Blues!

name: Bulmers
shortDesc: Bulmers has grown from humble beginnings as a local cidery on Dowd’s Lane in the heart of Clonmel to become Ireland’s largest cider brand, gaining international recognition as an iconically Irish brand.

name: Dew Valley
address: Holycross Road, Thurles, Co. Tipperary, Ireland
shortDesc: Thurles based Dew Valley Foods has grown from a craft butchers to Europe’s largest and leading cooked bacon manufacturer.

name: Glenpatrick
shortDesc: With 40 years of experience, Glenpatrick Spring is a leading manufacturer of water and soft drinks. We specialise in private label products for retailer house brands and brand co-manufacturing for global companies.

name: Merrys
shortDesc: Merrys Irish Cream Liqueur Merrys delicately blends fresh Irish dairy cream, fine aged Irish whiskey and natural flavours to create an award-winning range of premium Irish cream liqueurs renowned for their exceptional quality and taste.

name: Oakpark
shortDesc: At Oakpark, we’re proud to be a fourth-generation family business based in Tipperary. We craft award-winning sliced bacon, poultry, pudding and sous-vide products that bring the best of Irish food expertise to your table.

name: Blanco Nino
shortDesc: Clonmel-based Blanco Niño specialises in authentic corn tortillas and tortilla chips crafted using traditional Mexican methods. Founded by Philip Martin in 2015, the brand is built on a no-compromise commitment to premium-quality Mexican food. Since then, the business has grown from a niche tortilleria into a pan-European supplier with strong retail distribution and foodservice partnerships.

name: Ballybrado
shortDesc: Hardly any name in Ireland is so closely linked to the development of the organic sector than that of Ballybrado.Ballybrado was established in 1983 and has been involved in all stages of the organic life in Ireland: ranging from farm walks to consulting, to building organic certification bodies to being involved in governmental consulting groups – Ballybrado is a real original and proud to be organic.

name: Renegade
shortDesc: We are a small, family-owned business based in Cashel, Co Tipperary, since our arrival in September 2018 we have been welcomed warmly by the community. We are excited to introduce a taste South Africa to the Irish market.

name: Rivesci
shortDesc: Co-founded by husband & wife team Shannon Forrest and Declan Malone, Rivesci has grown from a food truck in Clonmel to Blas Na hEireann Supreme Champions with their award-winning condiment ranges.

name: Fitfix
shortDesc: Roscrea based snacking brand FitFix combines healthy protein enriched snacks with added functional benefits without compromising on taste. Fitfix vision was to create a healthy, great tasting protein snack with added functional benefits to satisfy that sweet craving. Today FitFix, offers not just a protein snack but a protein snack with functional benefits and a taste that is unparalleled!!

name: Ryans of Tipperary
shortDesc: Ryans of Tipperary brings generations baking hertiage into our modern, state of the art bakery. With three generations of the Ryan family involved in the confectionary business, we have developed the expertise, passion and commitment needed to deliver the highest qualitly confectionary cakes. Today Ryans is one of the biggest cake brands in Ireland!

name: Nutshed
shortDesc: Sisters Evie and Eliza are the food lovers behind The Nutshed. Born from a passion for good food and a proud family heritage, their single-origin peanut butters are now stocked in retail stores across the country.

name: Rosderra
shortDesc: Rosderra Irish Meats Group processes an extensive range of premium Pork and Bacon products for the Irish & International Markets. Our products areproduced from farms and factories in the Tipperary catchment area and across the country.​
